learning_outcomes.text: Adequate knowledge in mathematics, natural sciences, and the relevant engineering discipline; the ability to use theoretical and applied knowledge in these fields in solving complex engineering problems.
Ability to identify, formulate, and solve complex engineering problems; the ability to choose and apply appropriate analysis and modeling methods for this purpose.
Ability to design a complex system, process, device, or product under realistic constraints and conditions to meet specific requirements; the ability to apply modern design methods for this purpose.
Ability to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams.
Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing; proficiency in at least one foreign language; effective report writing and understanding of written reports.
